name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 3V — DIP
description: Through-hole 3V low-dropout (LDO) linear regulator ICs in DIP packaging, including DIP-8_W7.62mm footprints.
selection_hints: A 3V low-dropout linear regulator is needed in a through-hole DIP package.
The PCB layout calls for a DIP-8_W7.62mm footprint.
KiCad symbol linear regulator parts are preferred.
avoid_when: Surface-mount packaging is required rather than through-hole DIP.
An output voltage other than 3V is specified.
A switching regulator or non-LDO topology is required.
